milestones.title: Large bundled data is moved out of the package when it stops being needed; the limit was reviewed on 2026-11-25

remediation: CI checks the extension package against a 64 MiB sanity ceiling and 4,000 entries, which catch an accidental inclusion such as node_modules or source artwork; the former 14 MiB cap was self-imposed, and the owner raised it on 2026-11-25 ("keep it efficient, but it can grow"). The release-content job prints the package size and its change from main's last package, and warns when one change grows it by more than 1 MiB. Watch that report, and move large bundled data out of the package when it stops being needed.
title: The extension package's size is watched, not tightly capped
